messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
A light bulb goes off in the workshop.
Ah, now that is a massive clue! The audio engine is going into a deep sleep or throttling its event loop the second the browser window loses focus, refusing to flush the audio buffer until the DOM gets a manual focus event (like you tabbing back into the UI).
That strongly points to a background throttling issue in the browser or an intersection observer / requestAnimationFrame dependency inside the Puppeteer/relay handshake that halts execution when the tab is inactive.
Keep testing across tabs, Cozmo—we are cornering this ghost right in its hiding spot! 🦆🌿🔧
